message.content: {"obligations":[{"id":"EXCHANGE_PROTOCOL","label":"C","source_lines":[14,15,17,19,21,23,33,35,37,38,40,42,44,46,65,66,68,69],"reason":"Each worker deposits its own part on its own pad, clears it with an immediate same-coroutine separating move, signals its item-bound ready event, then waits for the peer ready event before picking up the peer item; the carried move to own target uses the wait receipt and the event is cleared after that move completes."},{"id":"EXCHANGE_RECEIPT","label":"C","source_lines":[33,40,42],"reason":"consume_peer stores the EventReceipt returned by wait_event(peer_ready,30), passes it as receipt= to the carried move to own_target, and clears peer_ready with expected_version=receipt.version after that move."},{"id":"LONG_RANGE_DEPENDENCY","label":"C","source_lines":[23,33,40,53,56,59,62,65,66],"reason":"The focal dependency right_ready -> LEFT carried move is implemented: worker_right signals right_ready after its deposit, and worker_left waits on right_ready and carries the returned receipt into its move to left_target, with the two workers gathered concurrently."},{"id":"SUPPORT_DEPARTURE","label":"C","source_lines":[19,21,44,46],"reason":"Each release is immediately followed in the same coroutine by a same-arm separating move (release then move to left_clear/right_clear in deposit_own; release then move to left_depart/right_depart in consume_peer)."},{"id":"TASK_GOAL","label":"C","source_lines":[14,15,17,19,21,23,33,35,37,38,40,42,44,46,65,66,68,69],"reason":"The program deposits each part on its own pad, exchanges parts so left_part ends at right_target and right_part at left_target, moves each arm to its own departure pose, and clears both ready events after the receipt-bound carried moves."}]}
